facades.name: pal_s_w
facades.source: Google Maps 3D view 2026 (oblique aerial, south): south front of the Archbishop's palace west of the pavilion
facades.look: a flat rectangular elevation of the Archbishop's palace south range: smooth pale blue-grey lime plaster, two storeys of small rectangular windows with plain white stone frames and dark glazing in a strict rhythm, a rusticated grey stone basement course, a simple eaves cornice; trees and the park in front of it are to be left out (continue the wall down to a stone plinth). No text.
